Prior rulings read: strict,timeout,http,warning,record-page,tier,two-column,stack → 100 hits; ADR-0023 Decision §4, ADR-0024 Decision §4, ADR-0082 Decision §6, ADR-0103 D3, ADR-0109 Decision §3, ADR-0002 Decision §6, ADR-0007 Decision §10, ADR-0007 Decision §8, ADR-0018 Decision §3, ADR-0022 Decision §4; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.
